data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding on a project whose 'git remote get-url origin' matches 'https://github.com/' or 'git@github.com:' writes dso.workflow=ci-pr to dso-config.conf
- DD2: When this story is complete, /dso:onboarding on a project with no origin, a GitLab remote, or an enterprise GitHub host writes dso.workflow=local to dso-config.conf

## Summary
Update plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md Phase 3 Step 2b.1 to replace the
legacy merge.strategy write with dso.workflow remote detection and write. This makes
the failing tests from T1 pass GREEN.

## Implementation Steps

### Phase 2 Question 11 update
Replace the current merge strategy dialog (asking user direct/pr choice) with:
- An explanation that the workflow mode is auto-detected from the GitHub remote at write time
- Keep as a passive informational step: "I'll detect your workflow mode from the git remote"
- Remove the MERGE_STRATEGY scratchpad variable from Phase 2 Q11 instructions
- If merge.strategy key exists in config (legacy), read it as a hint; otherwise derive from remote

### Phase 3 Step 2b.1 replacement
Replace the existing content:
  "Write merge.strategy=$MERGE_STRATEGY to .claude/dso-config.conf (overwrite any existing value)"

With the following instructions to the LLM agent:

**Step 2b.1: Workflow mode detection and write**

Skip guard: Before writing, check if dso.workflow is already present in
.claude/dso-config.conf. If dso.workflow already exists (non-empty value), skip
this write entirely — the config is already canonical. Log: "[DSO] dso.workflow
already set — skipping remote detection write."

Remote detection (when skip guard does not apply):
1. Run: git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null
2. If the URL matches 'https://github.com/' prefix OR 'git@github.com:' prefix:
   DETECTED_WORKFLOW=ci-pr
3. All other cases (empty URL / no origin, GitLab remote, enterprise GitHub host
   such as 'https://github.mycompany.com/', any other non-github.com URL):
   DETECTED_WORKFLOW=local
4. Note: Enterprise GitHub hosts MUST default to local — only exact 'github.com'
   (not 'github.mycompany.com' or similar) matches the ci-pr pattern.

Config write (bare key=value grammar — no quotes, no inline comments, LF line endings):
  echo "dso.workflow=$DETECTED_WORKFLOW" >> "$CONFIG_FILE"

On MERGE_STRATEGY=pr (from legacy Q11 if still set): if DETECTED_WORKFLOW=ci-pr,
also provision the GitHub Ruleset during Batch Group 4 (github-bootstrap.sh →
provision-ruleset.sh). This preserves the existing Ruleset provisioning behavior.

Remove the MERGE_STRATEGY=direct|pr conditional from downstream steps — replace all
references with dso.workflow=local|ci-pr semantic equivalents.

## Grammar Contract
The written line MUST conform to the migrator grammar (so a subsequent migrator
run is a no-op):
- Format: bare key=value with no surrounding whitespace variations
- No inline comments after the value (e.g., NOT: dso.workflow=ci-pr  # detected)
- No quoted values (e.g., NOT: dso.workflow="ci-pr")
- LF line endings (not CRLF)
- Line: dso.workflow=<value>\n exactly

## TDD Requirement
This task is GREEN — tests were written in T1. Running tests after this task
should turn T1's RED assertions GREEN:
  bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
  Must exit 0 (GREEN) after this task is complete.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 contains 'dso.workflow' write instruction
  Verify: grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 contains 'https://github.com/' detection pattern
  Verify: grep -q 'https://github\.com/' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 contains 'git@github.com:' detection pattern
  Verify: grep -q 'git@github\.com:' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 contains enterprise GitHub defaulting to local (no match on 'github.com' subdomain)
  Verify: grep -qiE 'enterprise.*local|enterprise.*default' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 contains skip guard for already-present dso.workflow
  Verify: awk '/Step 2b\.1/,/Step 2c/' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md | grep -qiE 'already.*(present|set|exists).*dso\.workflow|dso\.workflow.*already'
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2b.1 grammar guidance: no quotes around value
  Verify: awk '/Step 2b\.1/,/Step 2c/' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md | grep -qiE 'no.*quot|bare.*key.*value|key=value'
- [ ] T1 tests now pass GREEN (structural assertions satisfied)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
data.title: Update SKILL.md Phase 3 Step 2b.1 to write dso.workflow via GitHub remote detection
